description.text: GX Starter Deck: Legendary Clash, a Sun & Moon series product released as more TAG TEAM cards arrived: a random 60-card deck, ready to play, with damage counters, GX markers and a rule book; each deck always held one Pokémon-GX, along with Trainer cards often played in battles. This set holds every card the decks could contain. Its pool includes Arceus & Dialga & Palkia-GX and Charizard & Braixen-GX.
